description_en: Damage delivered to the native damage routine after attachment forwarding immunity and custom-unit armour.
description_zh: 传入原版伤害流程的数值；已经过附件伤害转移、伤害免疫和自定义单位护甲处理。

description_en: Damage passed into this custom unit before attachment forwarding immunity and custom-unit armour.
description_zh: 最初传入该自定义单位的伤害值；尚未经过附件伤害转移、伤害免疫和自定义单位护甲处理。

description_en: Actual non-negative HP reduction produced by this damage application.
description_zh: 本次伤害实际造成的非负生命值减少量。

description_en: Actual non-negative shield reduction produced by this damage application.
description_zh: 本次伤害实际造成的非负护盾值减少量。

description_en: Native return value containing damage left unapplied after shield and hull processing.
description_zh: 护盾和生命处理结束后未被应用的剩余伤害，即原版伤害方法的返回值。

description_en: HP immediately before the native damage routine.
description_zh: 进入原版伤害流程前的生命值。

description_en: HP immediately after the native damage routine.
description_zh: 完成原版伤害流程后的生命值。

description_en: Shield immediately before the native damage routine.
description_zh: 进入原版伤害流程前的护盾值。

description_en: Shield immediately after the native damage routine.
description_zh: 完成原版伤害流程后的护盾值。

description_en: True when a unit with positive HP reached zero or lower during this damage application.
description_zh: 若单位在本次伤害前生命值大于零并在之后降到零或更低，则为 true。

description_en: Native action ID of the queue item that was added.
description_zh: 加入队列的项目所对应的原版动作 ID。

description_en: Quantity carried by the native queue-change item.
description_zh: 原版队列变更项目携带的数量。

description_en: True when the queued action produces a unit.
description_zh: 若排队动作会生产单位则为 true。

description_en: Internal unit type produced by the queue item; omitted for non-unit actions.
description_zh: 队列项目生产的单位内部类型；非生产单位动作中省略。

description_en: Number of native queue entries before applying the action.
description_zh: 应用动作前的原版队列项目条目数。

description_en: Number of native queue entries after applying the action.
description_zh: 应用动作后的原版队列项目条目数。

description_en: True when the queued action supplied a world target point.
description_zh: 若排队动作提供了世界坐标目标点则为 true。

description_en: World X coordinate supplied to the queued action; omitted without a point target.
description_zh: 排队动作目标点的世界 X 坐标；没有点目标时省略。

description_en: World Y coordinate supplied to the queued action; omitted without a point target.
description_zh: 排队动作目标点的世界 Y 坐标；没有点目标时省略。

description_en: Unit target supplied to the queued action; omitted without a unit target.
description_zh: 排队动作收到的单位目标；没有单位目标时省略。

description_en: Native action ID of the queue item that was cancelled.
description_zh: 被取消队列项目所对应的原版动作 ID。

description_en: Quantity carried by the native queue-change item.
description_zh: 原版队列变更项目携带的数量。

description_en: True when the cancelled action produces a unit.
description_zh: 若被取消动作会生产单位则为 true。

description_en: Internal unit type produced by the cancelled item; omitted for non-unit actions.
description_zh: 被取消项目原本生产的单位内部类型；非生产单位动作中省略。

description_en: Number of native queue entries before applying the cancellation.
description_zh: 应用取消操作前的原版队列项目条目数。

description_en: Number of native queue entries after applying the cancellation.
description_zh: 应用取消操作后的原版队列项目条目数。

description_en: True when the cancelled action supplied a world target point.
description_zh: 若被取消动作提供了世界坐标目标点则为 true。

description_en: World X coordinate supplied to the cancelled action; omitted without a point target.
description_zh: 被取消动作目标点的世界 X 坐标；没有点目标时省略。

description_en: World Y coordinate supplied to the cancelled action; omitted without a point target.
description_zh: 被取消动作目标点的世界 Y 坐标；没有点目标时省略。

description_en: Unit target supplied to the cancelled action; omitted without a unit target.
description_zh: 被取消动作收到的单位目标；没有单位目标时省略。

description_en: Native order type assigned by the player.
description_zh: 玩家下达的原版命令类型。

description_en: World X coordinate stored in the new waypoint.
description_zh: 新路径命令中保存的世界 X 坐标。

description_en: World Y coordinate stored in the new waypoint.
description_zh: 新路径命令中保存的世界 Y 坐标。

description_en: Unit target stored in the new waypoint; omitted for point-only orders.
description_zh: 新路径命令中保存的单位目标；纯坐标命令中省略。

description_en: Native flag indicating that the player queued this waypoint behind another order.
description_zh: 原版标记：玩家是否把该路径命令追加到已有命令之后。

description_en: Internal build unit type carried by a build waypoint; omitted for other orders.
description_zh: 建造命令携带的单位内部类型；其他命令中省略。

description_en: Native action ID carried by the waypoint; omitted when none is assigned.
description_zh: 路径命令携带的原版动作 ID；没有动作 ID 时省略。

description_en: Numeric team ID immediately before the ownership change.
description_zh: 所有权改变前的数字队伍 ID。

description_en: Numeric team ID requested by the ownership change.
description_zh: 所有权改变所请求的新数字队伍 ID。

description_en: Alliance group of the old team.
description_zh: 原队伍所属的联盟组。

description_en: Alliance group of the new team.
description_zh: 新队伍所属的联盟组。

description_en: World X coordinate immediately before teleporting.
description_zh: 传送前一刻的世界 X 坐标。

description_en: World Y coordinate immediately before teleporting.
description_zh: 传送前一刻的世界 Y 坐标。

description_en: Unit height immediately before teleporting.
description_zh: 传送前一刻的单位高度。

description_en: Unit direction immediately before teleporting.
description_zh: 传送前一刻的单位朝向。

description_en: World X coordinate when the native teleported event is queued.
description_zh: 原版 teleported 事件入队时的世界 X 坐标。

description_en: World Y coordinate when the native teleported event is queued.
description_zh: 原版 teleported 事件入队时的世界 Y 坐标。

description_en: Unit height when the native teleported event is queued.
description_zh: 原版 teleported 事件入队时的单位高度。

description_en: Unit direction when the native teleported event is queued.
description_zh: 原版 teleported 事件入队时的单位朝向。

description_en: Actual child unit detached from the parent; fixes the native eventSource pointing back to the parent.
description_zh: 真正从父单位拆下的子单位；用于弥补原版 eventSource 错误指回父单位的问题。

description_en: Name of the attachment slot occupied before detaching.
description_zh: 拆卸前占用的附属槽位名称。

description_en: Numeric index of the attachment slot occupied before detaching.
description_zh: 拆卸前占用的附属槽位数字索引。

description_en: True when the detached child was also present in the parent's transported-unit list.
description_zh: 若被拆下的子单位同时存在于父单位的运输列表中则为 true。

description_en: Unit whose death caused this unit's native killedAnyUnit event.
description_zh: 触发本单位原版 killedAnyUnit 事件的死亡单位。

description_en: Internal type name of the killed unit.
description_zh: 被击杀单位的内部类型名。

description_en: Numeric team ID of the killed unit.
description_zh: 被击杀单位的数字队伍 ID。

description_en: World X coordinate of the killed unit when the event is queued.
description_zh: 事件入队时被击杀单位的世界 X 坐标。

description_en: World Y coordinate of the killed unit when the event is queued.
description_zh: 事件入队时被击杀单位的世界 Y 坐标。

description_en: Remaining HP of the killed unit at the native kill notification.
description_zh: 原版击杀通知发生时被击杀单位剩余的生命值。

description_en: Maximum HP of the killed unit.
description_zh: 被击杀单位的最大生命值。

description_en: True when the killed unit is classified as a building.
description_zh: 若被击杀单位属于建筑则为 true。

description_en: Unit produced by the completed native queue item.
description_zh: 由完成的原版队列项目生产出的单位。

description_en: Internal type name of the produced unit.
description_zh: 生产完成单位的内部类型名。

description_en: Numeric team ID of the produced unit after native placement.
description_zh: 原版完成放置后生产单位的数字队伍 ID。

description_en: World X coordinate of the produced unit after native placement.
description_zh: 原版完成放置后生产单位的世界 X 坐标。

description_en: World Y coordinate of the produced unit after native placement.
description_zh: 原版完成放置后生产单位的世界 Y 坐标。

description_en: Native action ID carried by the queue item that produced the unit.
description_zh: 生产该单位的队列项目所携带的原版动作 ID。

description_en: Quantity stored on the queue item at completion.
description_zh: 完成时该队列项目中保存的数量。

description_en: Target unit reached by the completed touch-target order.
description_zh: 接触目标命令成功完成时抵达的目标单位。

description_en: Internal type name of the touched target.
description_zh: 被接触目标的内部类型名。

description_en: Numeric team ID of the touched target.
description_zh: 被接触目标的数字队伍 ID。

description_en: World X coordinate of the touched target at success.
description_zh: 接触成功时目标的世界 X 坐标。

description_en: World Y coordinate of the touched target at success.
description_zh: 接触成功时目标的世界 Y 坐标。

description_en: Passenger newly accepted by this transport.
description_zh: 刚被本运输单位接收的乘员单位。

description_en: Internal type name of the newly transported passenger.
description_zh: 新装载乘员的内部类型名。

description_en: Numeric team ID of the newly transported passenger.
description_zh: 新装载乘员的数字队伍 ID。

description_en: World X coordinate stored on the passenger when loading completes.
description_zh: 装载完成时乘员保存的世界 X 坐标。

description_en: World Y coordinate stored on the passenger when loading completes.
description_zh: 装载完成时乘员保存的世界 Y 坐标。

description_en: Transport slots used immediately after accepting the passenger.
description_zh: 接收乘员后运输单位立即占用的运输槽位数。

description_en: Maximum transport slots reported by this carrier.
description_zh: 本运输单位报告的最大运输槽位数。

description_en: Passenger unloaded or removed from this transport.
description_zh: 刚从本运输单位卸载或移除的乘员单位。

description_en: Internal type name of the removed passenger.
description_zh: 被移除乘员的内部类型名。

description_en: Numeric team ID of the removed passenger.
description_zh: 被移除乘员的数字队伍 ID。

description_en: World X coordinate of the passenger at removal notification.
description_zh: 移除通知发生时乘员的世界 X 坐标。

description_en: World Y coordinate of the passenger at removal notification.
description_zh: 移除通知发生时乘员的世界 Y 坐标。

description_en: Transport slots still used after removing the passenger.
description_zh: 移除乘员后仍被占用的运输槽位数。

description_en: Maximum transport slots reported by this carrier.
description_zh: 本运输单位报告的最大运输槽位数。

description_en: Carrier entered by this passenger.
description_zh: 本乘员进入的运输单位。

description_en: Internal type name of the carrier.
description_zh: 运输单位的内部类型名。

description_en: Numeric team ID of the carrier.
description_zh: 运输单位的数字队伍 ID。

description_en: World X coordinate of the carrier when entry completes.
description_zh: 进入完成时运输单位的世界 X 坐标。

description_en: World Y coordinate of the carrier when entry completes.
description_zh: 进入完成时运输单位的世界 Y 坐标。

description_en: Carrier slots used immediately after this passenger enters.
description_zh: 本乘员进入后运输单位立即占用的运输槽位数。

description_en: Maximum transport slots reported by the carrier.
description_zh: 运输单位报告的最大运输槽位数。

description_en: Carrier just left by this passenger.
description_zh: 本乘员刚刚离开的运输单位。

description_en: Internal type name of the carrier.
description_zh: 运输单位的内部类型名。

description_en: Numeric team ID of the carrier.
description_zh: 运输单位的数字队伍 ID。

description_en: World X coordinate of the carrier when the leave event is queued.
description_zh: 离开事件入队时运输单位的世界 X 坐标。

description_en: World Y coordinate of the carrier when the leave event is queued.
description_zh: 离开事件入队时运输单位的世界 Y 坐标。

description_en: Carrier slots still used after this passenger leaves.
description_zh: 本乘员离开后运输单位仍占用的运输槽位数。

description_en: Maximum transport slots reported by the carrier.
description_zh: 运输单位报告的最大运输槽位数。

description_en: Internal type name snapshot of the message sender; use native eventSource for its unit reference.
description_zh: 消息发送单位的内部类型名快照；单位引用请使用原版 eventSource。

description_en: Numeric team ID snapshot of the message sender.
description_zh: 消息发送单位的数字队伍 ID 快照。

description_en: World X coordinate of the sender when the message is queued.
description_zh: 消息入队时发送单位的世界 X 坐标。

description_en: World Y coordinate of the sender when the message is queued.
description_zh: 消息入队时发送单位的世界 Y 坐标。

description_en: True when sendMessageWithTags supplied a native tag list.
description_zh: 若 sendMessageWithTags 提供了原版标签列表则为 true。

description_en: True when sendMessageWithData supplied a native event-data scope before enrichment.
description_zh: 若 sendMessageWithData 在扩展前提供了原版事件数据作用域则为 true。
